title: Print communications
slide_intent: Keep related publications recognizable while distinguishing their jobs, because visitors need to select the right information quickly.
strategic_value: Shared vertical signatures can connect a seasonal programme, monthly listing and visitor information despite their different content.
demonstration: Three overlapping narrow publications combine vertical MoMA marks with a blue seasonal field, a photographic monthly cover and a magenta information panel.
practical_value: Compare how color, imagery and headings distinguish publication functions within one signature system.

content_islands.name: Seasonal programme
content_islands.spec: Place the tall Winter/Spring 2009 piece behind at left with cyan text and information block.

content_islands.name: Monthly programme
content_islands.spec: Place the February 2009 photographic piece in front with its green date and vertical MoMA strip.

content_islands.name: Visitor information
content_islands.spec: Place the magenta English Plan/Information piece behind at right, retaining its white signature strip.

reference_purposes.Application: Three physical publication examples apply related signature treatments to different information products.
